<P ALIGN="CENTER">
<B>MINUTES OF THE MEETING OF THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS OF MSHIFT, INC.</B>
</P>

<P>
MShift, Inc.<BR>
1908 Thomes Ave, Cheyenne, WY 82001<BR>
Tel. (510) 933-5901 | Email: info@mshift.com<BR>
www.mshift.com
</P>

<P>
June 9, 2026<BR>
10:15 a.m. Pacific Time<BR>
via Telephonic Conference
</P>

<P>
The following are the minutes of the meeting of the Board of Directors (the "Board")
of MShift, Inc., a Wyoming corporation (the "Company"), held at the above time via
telephonic conference pursuant to notice duly given to all members of the Board.
Present at the meeting were directors Scott Moeller and Xiaomeng Zhou, representing
all of the members of the Board. All participants could hear and be clearly heard.
</P>

<P>
Mr. Moeller called the meeting to order. Mr. Moeller led the Board in a review and
discussion of American CryptoFed Constitution. After discussion by the Board, and upon
motion duly made and seconded, it was
</P>

<P>
<B>RESOLVED</B>, the matter of American CryptoFed Constitution is hereby ratified,
approved, and confirmed, in all respects.
</P>

<P>
There being no further business, the meeting was duly adjourned at 10:22 a.m.
Pacific Time.
</P>

<P>
/s/ Scott Moeller<BR>
Name: Scott Moeller<BR>
Title: CEO / Director of the Board<BR>
scott.moeller@mshift.com
</P>

<P>
/s/ Xiaomeng Zhou<BR>
Name: Xiaomeng Zhou<BR>
Title: COO / Director of the Board<BR>
xmzhou@mshift.com
</P>
